contract.intent: Amend journey-format-spec v10 -> v11: the TASK CONTRACT CHECKLIST — a task is self-sufficient when a fresh agent reads only its node.json contract + resolvable inputs and can execute without guessing. Checklist (1-3 enforced, 4-7 guidance): 1) intent non-empty 2) acceptanceCriteria non-empty, each non-empty 3) requiredInputs = logical names resolving via current() 4) targetAreas when files 5) expectedOutputs describing the conclusion (doc artifact or commit evidence) 6) openQuestions for known unknowns 7) work type determinable. Enforce F-AC19 at spawn (reject) + check (v9+ nodes).
acceptanceCriteria: journey-format-spec v11 (complete superseding): 2 gains the Task Contract Checklist (1-7, REQUIRED/SHOULD); 7 gains F-AC19
F-AC19 code: intent non-empty; acceptanceCriteria non-empty (each non-empty); every requiredInput resolves via current() (logical name, never path/guess)
spawn! rejects a non-compliant contract with named failures (task definers must follow the checklist)
check() flags F-AC19 violations for v9+ nodes (grandfathered pre-v9, same cutoff as F-AC18)
unit tests: good contract passes; missing intent / empty ACs / unresolvable input flagged; spawn rejection
v11 locked; v10 superseded; AGENTS.md re-pointed; suite green; check clean except documented legacy slips (task 13 input names)
